versions.changelog:
copilot-team-scaffold 1.0.1

- Enhanced AGENTS.md lifecycle enforcement: new gate and edit-tracking, AGENTS.md must be read/created before code changes, and synchronization is now validated after code edits.
- Updated runtime lifecycle: strengthened AGENTS.md gating at SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, and Stop events.
- Improved hook scripts: added/clarified logic for AGENTS.md blocking/reminders, edit tracking, and mandatory per-module AGENTS.md creation.
- Changelog: No file changes detected; the SKILL.md was updated for clearer AGENTS.md control and process detail.

copilot-team-scaffold 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a skill to scaffold a structured AI-assisted multi-agent development framework for any project.
- Automates creation of .github/ structure including agent definitions, automated hooks, dynamic prompts, and file-based planning.
- Collects project information interactively in two phases, supporting multiple tech stacks and agent roles.
- Dynamically generates AGENTS.md, per-agent files, instruction files, and specialized prompts tailored to the chosen stack and roles.
- Integrates with planning-with-files and spec-flow for traceable requirements-to-code workflow and persistent memory templates.
- Enforces code quality controls and multi-stage confirmation for smooth, auditable project bootstrapping.
